get.summary: List prime change orders for a project

parameters.name: dateTo
parameters.description: Filter PCOs up to this date

post.summary: Create a prime change order with line items
post.description: Creates a new PCO in DRAFT status. The pcoNumber is auto-generated as `PCO-{jobNumber}-{seq}`. Margin fields are auto-computed from amount and estimatedCost.

value.title: Additional steel reinforcement
value.description: Extra rebar needed due to soil conditions

404.description: Project, contact, change type, or cost code not found

get.summary: Get a prime change order by ID

put.summary: Update a prime change order (DRAFT only)
put.description: Partial update. Only DRAFT PCOs can be updated. Margin fields are auto-recomputed when amount or estimatedCost changes.

400.description: Only DRAFT change orders can be updated

delete.summary: Soft-delete a prime change order (DRAFT only)
delete.description: Soft-deletes the PCO and all its line items. Only DRAFT PCOs can be deleted.

400.description: Only DRAFT change orders can be deleted

get.summary: Get PCO pipeline KPIs for a project
get.description: Returns counts and totals by status for all PCOs in a project.

pipeline.description: Counts and sums grouped by status

post.description: Approves a PENDING_REVIEW PCO. Creator cannot approve their own PCO (segregation of duties). Records approval tracking fields and returns financial impact with contract values.

400.description: Only PENDING_REVIEW PCOs can be approved, or creator cannot approve own PCO

post.description: Rejects a PCO. Requires a reason (minimum 20 characters).

value.reason: Scope not justified per owner review and budget constraints

400.description: Invalid status for rejection or reason too short

post.description: Voids a PCO. Blocks if executed PCO has invoices. Reverses schedule entries if applicable.

400.description: Cannot void PCO with invoices or already voided

post.summary: Add a line item to a PCO
post.description: Adds a line item to a DRAFT PCO. Amount auto-computed as qty x unitPrice. Returns amountMismatch warning if line items total differs from PCO amount.

400.description: Only DRAFT PCOs can have line items added

404.description: PCO or cost code not found

put.description: Partial update of a line item on a DRAFT PCO. Amount auto-recalculated.

400.description: Only DRAFT PCOs can have line items updated

404.description: PCO or line item not found

delete.description: Removes a line item from a DRAFT PCO. Must have at least 1 line item remaining.

400.description: Only DRAFT PCOs, or cannot remove last line item

404.description: PCO or line item not found

get.summary: Get financial impact of a PCO
get.description: Returns before/after comparison with original contract value, approved PCO total, revised value, and budget limit.

put.description: Transitions are fully open — any non-terminal status can move to any other status. Terminal statuses: REJECTED and VOID (no transitions out). EXECUTED can only transition to VOID. On EXECUTED: if impactsSchedule, a schedule entry is auto-created and project dates recalculated. On VOID: linked schedule entries are soft-deleted and project dates recalculated. Reason is required for REVERTED, REJECTED, and VOID.

value.reason: Need better cost breakdown and schedule justification
GC penciled: reduced sprinkler qty from 100 to 50, adjusted pricing
Scope not justified per owner review

on-behalf-of.summary: Approve on behalf of another user

scheduleImpactDays.description: Days added to schedule (used when impactsSchedule is true)

contactId.description: GC contact this CO was sent to (Contact ID)

impactsSchedule.description: When true and status transitions to EXECUTED, a schedule entry is auto-created and project dates recalculated

estimatedCost.description: Used to auto-compute estimatedMargin and estimatedMarginPercent

PCOUpdateRequest.description: All fields optional (partial update). At least one field required. Set nullable fields to null to clear them.

status.description: Target status name. See endpoint description for valid transitions.

reason.description: Required for REVERTED, REJECTED, and VOID transitions

onBehalfOf.description: User ID if acting on behalf of someone else

PCOLineItemUpdateRequest.description: All fields optional (partial update). At least one field required.
